title: 'Pangarap lang natin 'to': SB19 talk joining Coachella 2027
summary: SB19's label, 1Z Entertainment, revealed Wednesday the P-pop group was 'shocked and speechless' when they first learned they would be part of 2027 Coachella lineup.
